Eref_base_J.role_note: Fixed base for s. Value is the V002 route-B seed (seed:11); REPLACED at PC-3 by the A2 re-anchored value before freeze. Bounds are engine-validity placeholders, never varied.

common_scale_s.box_rationale: Fixed-source field response is exactly proportional to 1/s, so the gravity-only indicator v^2 scales as 1/s. Box x[0.5,2] spans v^2 x[0.5,2] around the anchor. It covers the newest route-B reference spread (observed/predicted v^2 between about 0.87 and 1.42 across the 12 DDO154 rows; FR-MD:131 speeds vs region rows) plus the cube-to-sphere truncation shift (-9.9% to +1.8% in speed; FR-MD:166-168) with a factor ~1.4 margin per side. Computational only; it is not an empirical bound.
common_scale_s.exposed_without_native_resampling: YES: exact 1/s rescale of the unit response, no kernel rebuild (FR-MD:152; review row 28 CONFIRMED)
common_scale_s.natural_map: Eref_J := Eref_base_J ; gamma := gamma_over_Eref * Eref_base_J ; common_scale_s := s
common_scale_s.reanchor: Trial s=1 refers to Eref_base_J AFTER precondition PC-3 (A2 coefficients + converged truncation). Under A2 the anchor moves; the box is re-centred on the re-anchored base, not re-widened.
common_scale_s.units: dimensionless; multiplies BOTH Eref_base_J and gamma (driver 0466 per_call_seed: Eref_eff=s*Eref_J, gamma_eff=s*gamma)

distance_Mpc.box_rationale: Box = the reported conditional 68% interval exactly [3.981071706, 4.111497211] Mpc (region:118-119; modulus 28.03 [28.00, 28.07], calibration input geometry). No widening factor invented. The interval is NOT hard support (region:120); see declared item DI-3 for the edge rule.
distance_Mpc.exposure_status: NOT EXPOSED: driver 0466 refuses any distance != 4.04 (lines ~409-413 at read time: the D/4.3 scaling is baked into the pinned source JSON). Precondition PC-5.
distance_Mpc.forward_rule: r_model = r_catalogue*(D/4.04 Mpc); source angular geometry: lambda=D/4.3 Mpc, source radii x lambda, annular HI masses x lambda^2, angular-bin surface density unchanged (region:123; calibration input:1142)
distance_Mpc.transform_note: log D is linear in the distance modulus (region distance_summary is a monotone transform of the modulus)
distance_Mpc.trial_rationale: 4.04 Mpc = registered route-B geometry (driver 0466 registered_geometry; LIVE:37), inside the box; region central is 4.0365 Mpc.

ell_F_m.box_rationale: No ell_F response has been evaluated (UNTESTED). Box x[0.5,2] keeps the sampled primitive covector span of the composite cube between ~1.04 and ~4.16 reciprocal-lattice periods per axis (2.08 at the anchor; review row 7), i.e. at least one full period of the periodic native symbol is always sampled and node density per period stays >= ~17 of the 72 axis nodes. Purely numerical-coverage rationale; not physical.
ell_F_m.caution: ell_F enters the chart x = ell_F Cbar^{1/2} xi; Cbar itself changes under A2 (background M diag 0.613,1.462,0.630 -> 0.879,0.937,0.909; ROOT_DECISIONS:24).
ell_F_m.exposed_without_native_resampling: YES: one kernel rebuild (<=124 s) (FR-MD:154; review row 28)

gamma_over_Eref.box_rationale: Box = anchor x[0.1,10] = [2.00851e-18, 2.00851e-16]. Lower edge is the V008 ratio, whose current-source trial FAILED source preparation (FREE_BOUNDARY_NOT_BRACKETED at an outer column); upper edge is the x100-of-V008 current-source candidate, evaluated all-96-inward and retained as the evaluated alternative (seed V002 scope, line 88). On the fixed V006 thin-HI source the all-inward transition lies between 2.0e-19 (62/96 outward) and 2.0e-18 (0/96 outward); every evaluated ratio >=2.0e-18 was all-inward. Edges therefore sit on evaluated diagnostics; invalid evaluations near the lower edge are expected and are logged, never repaired by hand. All of this is V004-coefficient evidence: precondition PC-4 re-scans the ratio under A2 before freeze.
gamma_over_Eref.exposed_without_native_resampling: YES: one kernel rebuild (<=124 s) per new value (FR-MD:153; review row 28)
gamma_over_Eref.identifiability_indicator: Between ratio 2.0085e-17 and 2.0085e-16 at fixed Eref the 96 signed c^2 R dlnN/dR diagnostics scale with d log10(diag)/d log10(gamma) in [-0.9979, -0.9821]: within ~2% of pure 1/gamma. Indicator (V004, fixed V008 source, not a native/EH block separation, which stays UNTESTED per review row 10): expect the direction d ln s = -d ln gamma_over_Eref (gamma fixed, Eref varying) to be near-null. The engine SVD decides; a near-null direction is carried, never pinned.
gamma_over_Eref.units: gamma (as stored in seed numerical_inputs.gamma) per J of Eref; LIVE:53 gamma_bar correspondence not verified here

inclination_deg.box_rationale: Box = catalogue 64 +/- quoted mean error 3 = [61, 67] deg (calibration input:1147-1149; "not proved Gaussian or hard bounds"). Contains the source re-facing literal 66 (calibration input:1150).

inclination_deg.forward_rule: Varying i requires BOTH: (a) source re-deprojection (gas extracted in the 66 deg plane, stellar cos66/cos64 re-facing under a semimajor-radius assumption; LIVE:37; calibration input:1142 "Inclination/warp changes require corresponding source deprojection") and (b) forward projection of model motion through the adopted estimator and its 64 deg reference deprojection (region:124). The anchor applies sin66/sin64 (FR-MD:90).

native_fixed.crosswalk_caveat: LIVE:53 names "11 native ratios plus b". C178 lists the operator coordinates Ud, mu0, lambda_J, lambda_R, r, delta_cell, nu, h, t, g, |kappa|, |epsilon_B| and beta (C178 lines 486-620). The sampler trial dict uses different literal names (dstar, Delta, epsilon_c, epsilon_r, E_R, E_S, E_I, e_R, e_I, C_identity, epsilon, theta, ...). The literal-to-C178 crosswalk is NOT re-derived here; all 19 literals plus beta are carried so nothing is dropped. With Ud=1 and beta=1, every energy ratio X/Ud equals its literal and b=beta*Ud=1.
native_fixed.role_note: The 11 native ratios and b are NOT VARIABLE WITHOUT A NEW SAMPLER RUN (FR-MD:160; review row 28). They are carried at the A2 pooled point: the native trial literals shared by both A2 chains (cycle and admission results, identical "trial" dicts) with sampler beta=1, Ud=1. The forward wrapper must assert these literals equal the coefficient-grid provenance. Placeholder bounds never varied.

counted_assumptions.statement: Stationary circular streaming and m=0 equilibrium (A1-state); counted, not supplied by CI:75.
Kernel unmodified; only its m=0 projection drives the state; m>=1 residual stored (A1-response).
Disk axis = chart z, no orientation law (A1-orientation); tilt family UNTESTED.
m>=1 gas response NOT assumed small; evaluated linear response folded 19.26% of the mass; UNTESTED with artifact-free forcing (D3).
m=4/m=8 are numerical; truncation/k_max convergence settled BEFORE calibration (cube->sphere moves inner m0 force by up to 18.8%; no in-domain plateau rows 01-03).
Response coefficients = A2 4-chain pooled grid 2e3a36d8, PROVISIONAL, failed mixing, no error bars; V004-vs-pooled is sensitivity.
Native anisotropy may be failed-mixing error, not physics (UNTESTED).
Observation rectangles are Bonferroni z=2.865 conditional on unbiased Gaussian marginals with the quoted sigmas; not a posterior.
Systematics (source, distance, inclination, pressure, estimator transfer) are common nuisances; no per-row bias.
Distance enters only through the reported conditional 68% summary; not a likelihood; zero-point/extinction systematics retained.
Radius map r_model=r_cat*(D/4.04); source angular geometry at 4.3 Mpc scaled once.
Velocities compared to the published deprojected circular-speed estimate; sin(i) not re-applied; varied i is forward-projected through the adopted estimator.
sin66/sin64 fixed-plane observation map and cos66/cos64 stellar re-facing under a semimajor-radius assumption.
Inclination 64 deg with 3 deg quoted mean error is a catalogue summary, not Gaussian/hard bounds, and not independent of the calibration kinematics.
Common positive b=beta_native*Ud shared by DDO154 and NGC3198; per-galaxy b is a separate sensitivity that cannot inherit a target constraint.
Stellar radial: face-on intensity nodes, M/L3.6 0.5 reference with 0.4/0.6 alternatives, constant core and exponential outer tail are model assumptions.
Stellar vertical sech^2 with h_star=Rd/7.3; 5.1/9.5 and flagged photometry are source sensitivities.
HI finite-support polytrope P=K rho^Gamma, Gamma 5/3 (1.4 alt), sigma0 11 km/s (8,14 sensitivity) is a preparation assumption, not a measurement.
N-only/Nrot vertical gas shape is a leading approximation requiring stationary axisymmetric circular flow.
Helium included once (1.36 in source packet; SPARC 1.33 is an alternative); neither is an empirical distribution.
Leading rest-energy source; stress and kinetic corrections are separate columns; no quantitative bound.
Missing/masked HI, exterior mass and DDO154 H2 set to zero extra only in the restricted reference; no empirical bound.
Observed-mass registration dM=Sigma_ref R dR dphi with full-metric column quadrature.
HI-weighted mean of R*Omega per column is the row observable of route B (counted estimator approximation; exact compiled-row weighting undocumented).
The 11 native ratios and b are fixed at the A2 sampler point; 12 observations do not generically identify 15 coordinates; unconstrained directions are preserved.
Gamma_total = gamma*I_R + Gamma_native + Gamma_b with zero extra vacuum term; net gamma independently calibrated.
Proper-time V002 is provisional and counted.
Positive-cardinal spatial response closure is a counted finite-registration approximation with no infinite-volume tail bound.
Isolated zero-perturbation boundary, no tide or exterior source; stars fixed analytic rings.
Gamma-ratio and s boxes are justified from V004-coefficient diagnostics; they must be re-checked under A2 (PC-4).

declared_items_for_freeze.proposed: DECLARED (DI-1): each admitted branch is carried as a separate alternative in the Module-2 "alternatives" field; the frozen 43-point envelope is the union over admitted branches with per-branch envelopes reported; no branch is selected by DDO154 fit quality alone and never by NGC3198.

declared_items_for_freeze.item: Tier-2 linearised protocol and promotion rule
declared_items_for_freeze.proposed: Each tier-2 branch: one seed call at the BR-A anchor u, then a linearised repair using the BR-A Jacobian, then ONE verification call at the linearised admitted point. Promotion rule: if the verification call is not admitted, or its 12 speeds differ from the linear prediction by more than 1 quoted sigma on any row, the branch is promoted to the full engine procedure with its own budget. This is a DECLARED computational protocol (DI-2), not part of the frozen 0462 engine.

If any admitted hull extreme touches a distance or inclination box face (engine hit_box_edge or hull within one bisection resolution of the face), the region is reported EDGE_LIMITED and the branch is rerun with half-widths doubled in modulus (distance) and in degrees (inclination: [58,70]); both regions are reported.

Saved route-B Picard change was 0.0095 km/s between iterations (FR-MD:120). With rel_step 0.05 the D column (radius change 0.16%) gives at most ~0.02 km/s on row 01: at the FD noise floor. Rule (DI-4): a direction counts as identified only if s_i >= null_tolerance*s_max AND s_i exceeds the FD noise singular value sqrt(12)*dv_picard/(2*rel_step*min sigma); otherwise it is reported near-null. Tighten picard.speed_change_bound_km_s for Jacobian calls if D/i must be resolved.
K factor relative to K(sigma0=11, Gamma) computed by the binding static_profile rule for that Gamma.
BR-A (route-B newest reference K=64/121) and BR-K1 (binding reference sigma0=11) both full; neither preferred before evaluation.

axis_definitions.meaning: K relative to K(sigma0=11 km/s) at the original density; K = sigma0^2 rho0^(1-Gamma) (binding V003 static_profile) so the factor is (sigma0/11)^2: 64/121 <-> 8 km/s, 1 <-> 11 km/s (binding reference), 196/121 <-> 14 km/s.
axis_definitions.note: The task's "HI sigma0" alternative IS this axis at fixed density; it is not carried twice. For the Gamma=1.4 branch the factor is relative to K(11 km/s, Gamma=1.4) by the same static_profile rule (declared, DI-5).

per_call_cost_estimate.note: Sum of the saved chain stage receipts (route_a through column_mean). A parameter change reruns every stage. The 72 columns are independent; inside-call column workers trade against the 12-way width on 18 cores.

speed_levers: Columns of the Jacobian are independent: the 3 free-coordinate columns (exposed today) can run before the D/i driver extension (PC-5) exists; D/i columns join the same cache later and the engine is run once all 10 are present.
Tier-2 branches use 2 calls each instead of a full exploration unless promoted.
Pure-s changes need no kernel rebuild (exact 1/s rescale) if the driver reuses the unit response.

totals_estimate.note: Wall estimate = waves x serial per-call time; 12-way contention not measured (UNTESTED). Engine-sequential steps are replayed from a theta-keyed cache filled by parallel waves (0463 Module D design, now superseded by the 0466 campaign); replay must make zero new calls.
